old_value: {"id":"JMAP-4vf8.8","title":"Message/set local delete (deletedAt only) does not purge body/attachments/editHistory","description":"crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:742-748. The content purge runs only when the patch has deletedForAll:true. A local delete, update {\"deletedAt\": \"\u003cts\u003e\"} with no deletedForAll, goes to the backend unchanged, so Message/get still returns the full body, attachments and editHistory on a message that has deletedAt set. Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 line 688 (deletedAt: 'When set, body is empty, attachments is empty, and editHistory is absent'), and §Deleting a Message line 1161 ('Otherwise, deletion is local only: body and attachments are cleared on this mailbox'). The handler's own comment cites the deletedAt rule but keys the purge on deletedForAll. Fix: purge whenever the patch sets a non-null deletedAt OR deletedForAll:true.
